profile.name: Fathom Analytics
profile.discovery_reason: The closest head-to-head pick for a buyer who wants a flat-fee, cookieless, single-dashboard tool across multiple sites instead of Plausible's pageview-tiered pricing.
profile.one_liner: Fathom is a Google Analytics alternative that makes your analytics easy to understand and respects visitor privacy.
profile.promise: That you get a Google Analytics-grade view of your traffic and conversions without using cookies, collecting personal data, or showing a cookie banner — privacy-first analytics that stays simple.

claims.text: Fathom's hero tagline positions it as cookieless analytics
claims.verbatim: Analytics without the cookies

claims.text: Fathom describes itself as a Google Analytics alternative that is easy to understand and privacy-respecting
claims.verbatim: Fathom is a Google Analytics alternative that makes your analytics easy to understand and respects visitor privacy.

claims.text: Offers a 7-day free trial
claims.verbatim: 7-day free trial

claims.text: Customers can cancel anytime
claims.verbatim: Cancel anytime

claims.text: The whole company is built around digital privacy
claims.verbatim: Our entire company is built on putting digital privacy first.

claims.text: As a Canadian company, Fathom says it is covered by Canada's EU adequacy decision for EU traffic
claims.verbatim: as a Canadian company, we're covered by Canada's EU adequacy decision.

claims.text: Fathom says it is GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy and PECR compliant
claims.verbatim: Plus, we're GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy, PECR (and more) compliant.

claims.text: Fathom claims other analytics tools miss real visitors due to blockers, cookies and sampling
claims.verbatim: Plenty of analytics tools miss real people because of blockers, cookies and sampling.

claims.verbatim: and attach a monetary value to see more than pageviews.

claims.text: Fathom advertises unlimited data retention
claims.verbatim: Unlimited data retention

claims.text: History is kept for as long as you remain a customer
claims.verbatim: We keep your analytics history for as long as you're a customer.

profile.pricing: Pageview-tiered plans shared across all sites on the account: $15/month for up to 100,000 monthly pageviews (50 sites included) rising through $25/$45/$60/$100/$140/$200/$290/$380/$470 per month up to 25,000,000 monthly pageviews, with 'Custom' pricing for 'Over 25,000,000 monthly pageviews'; extra site packs cost $10/month (or $100/year) per 50 sites, up to 15 packs; custom events count toward the pageview allowance; every plan starts with a 7-day free trial.
profile.free_entry: 7-day free trial requiring a card ('Your card is not charged until the trial ends, and we'll email you before your plan starts billing'); no indefinite free tier; a no-signup live demo dashboard is also offered ('View a live demo').
profile.icp: Positioned for buyers who want a privacy-focused Google Analytics alternative; described on-page as used by 'Fortune 100s, pioneers of the Open Web, Premier League football clubs, banks, and governments around the world,' with dedicated sections for European companies and agencies.
profile.note: 1 claim(s) the extractor reported were not on their pages and were discarded
